title: Tom and His Comic Strip
text:
Tom likes comic strips very much. Every Sunday, he reads the funny comics in the newspaper. His favorite comic has a small dog and a big cat. The dog always makes the cat laugh.

One day, Tom draws his own comic strip. It has three boxes and a happy dog. His sister reads it and smiles. Tom wants to make more comics next week.

questions.text: What does Tom read every Sunday?
options: The funny comics in the newspaper

questions.text: How many boxes does Tom's comic strip have?
How does Tom probably feel about comics?
options: He thinks they are too expensive

questions.text: What can the reader guess about Tom's sister?
options: She draws comics for the newspaper

vocabulary.definition: a story told in pictures, often funny
printed news published every day or week
to make sounds of joy when something is funny

paragraph_translations: A Tom le gustan mucho las tiras cómicas. Cada domingo lee los cómics divertidos del periódico. Su cómic favorito tiene un perro pequeño y un gato grande. El perro siempre hace reír al gato.
Un día, Tom dibuja su propia tira cómica. Tiene tres viñetas y un perro feliz. Su hermana la lee y sonríe. Tom quiere hacer más cómics la próxima semana.
